name: bodyPress
summary:
Your body writes a journal every day — BodyPress reads it.

BodyPress turns your health data into a daily first-person story. Instead of staring at numbers and charts, you read a warm, insightful narrative written as if your body is speaking to you — revealing patterns and correlations you'd otherwise miss.

⚠️ HEALTH NOTICE
BodyPress is a general wellness and self-reflection tool. It is NOT a medical device and does NOT provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always consult a qualified healthcare
